subject: Recording, slides & a quick Q&A — checking timing for VoyagerTech
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@voyagertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recording, slides & a quick Q&A — VoyagerTech discovery

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn about VoyagerTech's ingestion pipeline and the three places you called out where latency and embedding costs matter most. Per our call, I dropped the recording and the slide deck below so your team can share internally. Quick summary:

- What we covered: architecture fit, batch vs streaming tradeoffs, and our dedicated routing option for lower tail latency.
- Next-best technical wins: prefix caching for your 3rd-party doc store and a light quantization profile for the retrieval-heavy endpoints.
- Open items you flagged: procurement timing and expected P95 latency under the 1M qps simulation.

Recording: https://drive.redwood.com/recordings/voyagertech-demo-20280328
Attachments: VoyagerTech_demo_slides.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)

Would you be open to a short 15-minute Q&A for the broader team (we can cover latency numbers, cost estimates, and a sample mutual action plan)? I have the following slots next week:
- Tue 4/3 10:00–10:15 PDT
- Wed 4/4 14:00–14:15 PDT
- Thu 4/5 09:30–09:45 PDT

If those don't work, tell me a couple of 10–15 minute windows and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the follow-up and the deck — I passed both to the infra and procurement teams. A couple quick questions before we lock a slot:

1) Can you share a ballpark cost delta between hosted vs dedicated for the pattern we discussed (embedding-heavy, lots of short queries)? Rough order of magnitude is fine.
2) We ran an internal sim — curious if you have P95 latency numbers for the dedicated path with prefix caching enabled (for 99% of our sample the sequence length is < 256).

We are interested in a short sync. Tue 4/3 10:00 PDT would work for two of us (I can clear the calendar). Could you also include the procurement contact in the invite so they can flag any contract timing constraints?

Thanks —
Alex Li
Director, Platform Engineering — VoyagerTech
alex.li@voyagertech.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Recording, slides & a quick Q&A — VoyagerTech discovery

Alex —

Perfect — I’ll lock Tue 4/3 10:00–10:15 PDT and send a calendar invite now (link below). For the two quick items you asked about:

- Ballpark cost differential: for embedding-heavy short queries the dedicated pool (midsize) with batching and prefix caching typically runs ~35–45% below hosted per-token unit cost at steady-state (depends on qps and sequence mix). I’ll include a short one-pager in the invite with assumptions.
- P95 latency: with prefix caching and our optimized kernels we’ve seen P95s in the 45–90ms range for sequence lengths < 256 on the dedicated tiers we benchmarked — I’ll bring a chart with the caveats about synthetic vs production traffic.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/VT-2394-15min-qa
Attachments: VoyagerTech_demo_recording.mp4 (MP4, 52MB), VoyagerTech_demo_slides.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)

If procurement wants an NDA or specific SSO/KMS notes ahead of time, loop them here and I’ll escalate to our security lead for a short checklist.

See you Tuesday —
Evelyn
